SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cds")
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc."cdscode" = s."cds"
WHERE s."avgscrmath" > 560
  AND sc."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."phone",
        ss."sname",
        ss."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(ss."numtsttakr", 0) AS excellence_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY ss."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(ss."numtsttakr", 0) DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" ss
    JOIN "schools" s
        ON s."cdscode" = ss."cds"
    WHERE ss."numtsttakr" IS NOT NULL
      AND ss."numtsttakr" > 0
      AND ss."numge1500" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "phone"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY rn;

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    s."charternum" AS charter_number,
    AVG(ss."avgscrwrite") AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE ss."avgscrwrite" > 499
  AND s."charternum" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s."charternum") <> ''
GROUP BY s."school", s."charternum"
ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT s.cds, s.sname, s.avgscrread
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT t.sname,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" AS frpm_count_ages_5_17
FROM top_school t
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = t.cds;

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT fname, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY fname
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)

SELECT nc.fname, an.district
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an.fname = nc.fname
GROUP BY nc.fname, an.district
ORDER BY nc.fname, an.district;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.school = 'Youth Authority School'
  AND s.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040';

SELECT
    s."ncesschool" AS nces_school_id,
    f."School Name" AS school_name,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s
    ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
GROUP BY s."ncesschool", f."School Name"
ORDER BY total_enrollment_ages_5_17 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(s.numtsttakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.county = 'Fresno'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.opendate) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM schools s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."sname",
        s."avgscrmath",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrmath" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sc."school",
    sc."mailstreet" AS postal_street_address
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sc
    ON sc."school" = r."sname"
WHERE r.rn = 7

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."avgscrwrite",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sc."phone",
    sc."ext"
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sc
    ON sc."cdscode" = r."cds"
WHERE r.rn = 333;

WITH school_totals AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.cname,
        s.dname,
        s.avgscrmath,
        s.avgscrread,
        s.avgscrwrite,
        (s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite) AS total_avg
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
      AND s.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
      AND s.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    st.avgscrmath AS average_math_score,
    sc.county
FROM school_totals st
JOIN schools sc
    ON sc.cdscode = st.cdscode
ORDER BY st.total_avg ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s."street",
    s."city",
    s."zip",
    s."state"
FROM "satscores" AS ss
JOIN "schools" AS s
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE ss."numtsttakr" IS NOT NULL
  AND ss."numtsttakr" > 0
  AND ss."numge1500" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (ss."numge1500"::numeric / ss."numtsttakr"::numeric) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    AVG(ss."avgscrwrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."phone" AS communication_number
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" ss
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY
    s."school",
    s."phone"
ORDER BY
    avg_writing_score DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
    ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE (s."admfname1" = 'Kacey' AND s."admlname1" = 'Gibson')
   OR (s."admfname2" = 'Kacey' AND s."admlname2" = 'Gibson')
   OR (s."admfname3" = 'Kacey' AND s."admlname3" = 'Gibson');

WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
      AND s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."closeddate" <> ''
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
    ORDER BY closed_count DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."county",
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN county_counts cc
  ON cs."county" = cc."county"
ORDER BY cs."school";

SELECT DISTINCT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s."opendate" IS NOT NULL
  AND s."opendate" <> ''
  AND s."opendate" > DATE '2000-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT
    f."District Code" AS district_code
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
    ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."admfname1" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."admfname2" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."admfname3" = 'Alusine';

SELECT
    s.city,
    s.school,
    f."Low Grade" AS lowest_grade
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
  AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.latitude ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."admemail1"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE LOWER(s.fundingtype) = 'locally funded'
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    s.school,
    s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE LOWER(s.fundingtype) = 'locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > a.avg_difference
ORDER BY s.school;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."sname", ss."numge1500"
    FROM satscores ss
    ORDER BY ss."numge1500" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s."school",
    s."admfname1" AS "admin_first_name_1",
    s."admlname1" AS "admin_last_name_1",
    s."admfname2" AS "admin_first_name_2",
    s."admlname2" AS "admin_last_name_2",
    s."admfname3" AS "admin_first_name_3",
    s."admlname3" AS "admin_last_name_3"
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school ts
  ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds";

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."county" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s."charter" = 0
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18;

SELECT "c"."artist"
FROM "cards" AS "c"
WHERE "c"."side" IS NULL
  AND "c"."convertedmanacost" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "c"."convertedmanacost" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."name") AS card_count
FROM cards c
WHERE c."artist" = 'John Avon'
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."originaltype" = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND c."subtypes" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."subtypes" <> 'Angel';

SELECT
    "c"."id" AS "card_id"
FROM "cards" AS "c"
WHERE LOWER(TRIM("c"."bordercolor")) = 'black'
ORDER BY "c"."id";

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
  AND c."promotypes" = 'arenaleague'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    fd."language",
    fd."flavortext",
    c."type"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."watermark" = 'colorpie'

SELECT "keywords"
FROM "cards"
WHERE "name" = 'Angel of Mercy'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."convertedmanacost"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."name" = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT "id"
FROM "sets"
ORDER BY "basesetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'Aaron Miller'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL;

WITH mythic_cards AS (
    SELECT
        c."uuid",
        c."name",
        c."originalreleasedate",
        c."rarity"
    FROM "cards" c
    WHERE LOWER(c."rarity") = 'mythic'
      AND c."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
      AND c."originalreleasedate" <> ''
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT
        mc."uuid",
        mc."name",
        mc."originalreleasedate"
    FROM mythic_cards mc
    ORDER BY
        
        CAST(mc."originalreleasedate" AS DATE) ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    o."name" AS card_name,
    o."originalreleasedate" AS release_date,
    l."format" AS legal_format
FROM oldest o
LEFT JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = o."uuid"
   AND LOWER(l."status") = 'legal'
ORDER BY l."format";

SELECT st."translation"
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st
  ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
 AND st."language" = 'French'
WHERE c."name" = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st."language" = 'Japanese' THEN s."code" END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s."code"), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "sets" s
LEFT JOIN "set_translations" st
    ON st."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."type" = 'expansion';

SELECT DISTINCT
    l."status"
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."types" = 'Artifact'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
  ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
JOIN "rulings" r
  ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'premodern'
  AND r."text" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c."side" IS NULL;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND "istextless" = 0) AS spotlight_without_text,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND "istextless" = 0)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards"

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."code") AS sets_count
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st
  ON st."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese'
  AND (s."mtgocode" IS NULL OR s."mtgocode" = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."uuid") AS card_count
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."name" = 'Abundance'
  AND c."rarity" = 'rare'
  AND c."types" = 'Enchantment'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
  
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM legalities l2
    WHERE l2."uuid" = c."uuid"
      AND l2."status" <> 'Legal'
  );

SELECT
    c."id" AS card_id,
    c."name" AS card_name,
    c."artist" AS artist,
    r."text" AS ruling_text,
    CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_missing_or_degraded
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "rulings" r
    ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" ILIKE '%Stephen Daniel%'
ORDER BY c."id", r."date";

SELECT DISTINCT
    s."name" AS set_name,
    s."code" AS set_code,
    s."mtgocode" AS mtgo_code,
    CASE WHEN s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS appeared_on_mtgo
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" = 'Angel of Mercy'
ORDER BY s."name";

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" AS s
WHERE s."type" = 'commander'
ORDER BY s."totalsetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c."name" AS card_name,
    c."uuid" AS card_uuid,
    c."hascontentwarning" AS has_content_warning,
    r."text" AS ruling_text
FROM "cards" c
LEFT JOIN "rulings" r
    ON r."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" = 'Jim Pavelec'
ORDER BY c."name", r."date";

SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name" AS card_name,
    l."format" AS format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s
    ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN legalities l
    ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE s."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
ORDER BY c."name", l."format";

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(c."id"), 0) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'commander'
  AND l."status" = 'legal';

SELECT
    
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage_nonfoil_only
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd
    ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese'

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
          AND fd."language" = 'French'
    )::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
    ), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd
    ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid";

SELECT DISTINCT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "cards" c ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."isforeignonly" = 1
  AND s."isfoilonly" = 1
  AND fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
    
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN fd."language" = 'French' THEN 1 END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT DISTINCT c."artist"
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."artist" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy');
